summary: Iteration 8 — 25 rigs + Yard + searchable dropdown + rig-scoped chat + server-persisted checklist events + activity summary + handover modal. Backend 15/15 pytest PASSED. Frontend UI flows all PASS (26 rigs, search filter, RIG5 select + reload persistence via ctp_active_rig_v2, chat isolation RIG5<->RIG7, HandoverModal opens with all 6 sections and Copy-to-Clipboard writes plain text starting with 'HANDOVER SUMMARY', checklist check/uncheck POSTs /api/crew/checklist-events with correct action). Invite redeem via a lifetime code confirmed grant_days=3650.

ui_bugs.issue: The persistent bottom-of-viewport 'Advisory only — Educational & computational tool …' banner overlaps the CrewChat send button ([data-testid=chat-send-btn]) at ~900-1024px tall viewports (mobile/laptop). Playwright reports 'advisory-modal intercepts pointer events' and real users would tap the banner instead of Send. Enter-to-send still works (verified). Recommend giving the chat panel bottom-padding equal to the banner height OR making the banner z-index below the chat input.

issues: 'All data filtered by rig' text at #666 on #1E1E1E is very faint — carry-over from iter7, still worth bumping to #9CA3AF for consistency.

action_items: Fix z-index / bottom-padding so the sticky Advisory banner does not overlap CrewChat send button at ~900px tall viewports (only real functional UI issue found).
critical_code_review_comments: CrewChat useEffect adds `markSeen` to deps of the polling effect and also runs on every messages.length change — combined with the interval, markSeen is called far more often than necessary. Not a bug but wasteful (writes to localStorage every 3s while the tab is open).
RigContext.fetchActivity polls /api/crew/activity-summary every 15s unconditionally — even when the user isn't authenticated or has no team. Suggestion: short-circuit when user is null.
HandoverModal buildText assumes s.completed_tasks/alerts/etc are always arrays; server does return them but a defensive `?? []` would help if the endpoint ever returns null on error.
server.py crew_handover_summary duplicates the '$or rig_or_legacy' block inline for parts_open/todos_open/inv_flags instead of reusing `rig_or_legacy`. Minor DRY violation, easy fix.
server.py is now ~1350 lines — consider splitting rig/crew/handover endpoints into separate routers for maintainability (guideline threshold 700 lines).

rca of the issue: Send-button click intercept: `AdvisoryDisclaimer` renders a fixed banner at the bottom of the page (z-index above the rest of the layout). At viewport heights around 900px the CrewChat's input row lands under this banner. Playwright reports 'advisory-modal intercepts pointer events' repeatedly on chat-send-btn. Repro: 1) Open /team at 1280x900. 2) Dismiss the safety modal. 3) Select CHAT tab. 4) Try to click Send — pointer events are captured by the fixed banner. Mitigation: (a) add bottom padding to the .flex.flex-col container equal to banner height, or (b) drop banner z-index below sticky UI, or (c) make banner position:sticky within a scroll container rather than position:fixed.
